name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind) — 2 Intermediate — Dual Thought

system.description: By spending a temporary Willpower Trait, the thaumaturge may take an extra Mental action during her turn, performing two Mental-based tasks or Disciplines simultaneously with equal acumen. Each action still requires its normal costs and challenges, and no more blood may be spent per turn than the thaumaturge's generation allows. This power lasts for one scene or 10 minutes.
